### 🔵 Needs a closer look The change is small, correct, and well-tested, but it alters user-facing diagnostic behavior in the security/preflight path and warrants a final human confirmation. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR `chroxy doctor`'s port-availability check previously always probed `8765` unless the `-p/--port` flag was passed, ignoring a `port` set in `config.json` or the `PORT` env var — even though `chroxy start` honours both. This made the diagnostic misleading: it could report `8765 is available` while `start` would actually bind (and potentially conflict on) a different port. This PR routes doctor's port resolution through the same `mergeConfig` precedence that `start` uses, so the two can no longer drift. **Changes:** - In `runDoctorChecks`, the probed port is now resolved via `mergeConfig` (precedence: `-p` flag → `PORT` env → `config.json` `port` → `8765`), fed the config doctor already parsed, instead of `port || 8765`. - Adds a `DEFAULT_PORT` constant and updates the JSDoc for `options.port` to document the new resolution. - Adds `doctor-cmd-port.test.js` covering each precedence tier at both the `runDoctorChecks` library level and the real `doctor` command, plus a start-parity assertion against `loadAndMergeConfig(...).port`. This change is consistent with the existing doctor.js convention of resolving "what `start` would use" (provider via `resolveProviders`, binary-provenance via `resolveBinaryProvenanceMode`) through the shared loader rather than a hand-rolled read. `start`'s own preflight already passes its merged port as the CLI tier, so its behaviour is unchanged. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `packages/​server/​src/​doctor.js` | Resolve the Port-check port via `mergeConfig` (flag > `PORT` > config `port` > `DEFAULT_PORT`) instead of always `8765`; add `DEFAULT_PORT` and update JSDoc. | | `packages/​server/​tests/​doctor-cmd-port.test.js` | New isolated tests covering every precedence tier at the library and CLI levels, plus a start-parity check, all under temp `CHROXY_CONFIG_DIR`/`HOME`. |
Review effort: Balanced
